Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of a compound of G2819 and G1325; to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate:--divide by lot.
BiblicalUsage: God destroyed seven nations in Canaan and divided their land to His people by lot.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the land was gift, not conquest, because God gave what Israel could never have taken alone.
